title: Get KP ruling planets with optional significators

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees. Any latitude for the ruling planets alone; with birthDate and birthTime the significators read Placidus cusps, so the latitude must lie below 66.56 degrees north or south and a polar latitude returns 400.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Timezone: IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London") OR decimal hours from UTC. An IANA name is resolved to the DST-correct offset of each moment separately: at datetime for the ruling planets, and at birthDate and birthTime for the significators. A decimal is applied to both as sent. Defaults to 5.5.

fields.name: datetime
fields.description: ISO 8601 datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) for ruling planets. Defaults to current time. Interpreted as local time when a non-zero timezone is provided (a trailing Z is accepted but ignored); with timezone 0 it is UTC.

fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Birth date (YYYY-MM-DD) to calculate significators. If provided with birthTime, response includes which houses each ruling planet signifies.

fields.name: birthTime
fields.description: Birth time (HH:MM:SS) for significator calculation. Required if birthDate is provided.

fields.name: nodeType
fields.description: Lunar node convention. "mean" is the smoothed average node, which always moves retrograde; "true" is the osculating node, which tracks the real perturbed node, oscillates up to about 1.5 degrees either side of the mean on a 173-day cycle, and can briefly turn direct. Neither is more correct and they almost always fall in the same sign. Applies to the Rahu and Ketu positions. Mean is the traditional Vedic default and what printed panchangs use; the choice can move a KP sub-lord in narrow boundary cases, where a span can be as small as 0.5 degrees. Defaults to "mean".

fields.name: focus
fields.description: Which signification vocabulary the houseThemes map returns. "general" gives the classical bhava significations (self, wealth, siblings, home, and so on). "finance" gives the money reading of the same twelve bhavas, so house 2 returns income and savings, 5 speculation and risk appetite, 8 sudden money and leverage, 11 gains and profits, and 12 expenses and capital outflow. Use "finance" for wealth, income, business and market timing questions in Krishnamurti Paddhati, where the significator house groups 2, 6, 10, 11 for earned income and 5, 8, 11 for speculation are read against a running dasha. Defaults to "general".
